content.text: Since the Axka Exxon tanker disaster in 1989 and the 1991 Middle East war, the price of aviation fuel has risen dramatically.During the same period, the prices of several petroleum derivatives also rose sharply.These two facts indicate that aviation fuel is a petroleum derivative.

content.thinking:
The argument is: Aviation fuel prices rose + petroleum derivative prices rose → therefore aviation fuel is a petroleum derivative.

This is a classic correlation fallacy. Two things rising in price at the same time doesn't prove one belongs to the other category. Option C points this out with a good analogy: food prices also rose, but that doesn't make aviation fuel food.

C is the best answer.
